items.caption: This bronze-script form of 日 has a rounded rectangular outline with a filled oval at its center. It shows a later visible form of the sun pictogram; the image does not establish how the earliest graph was made.
items.alt: A thick, rounded rectangular black outline surrounds a smaller filled black oval.
items.selection_reason: The clear outline and central mark help readers see 日’s shape in a form attributed to a mid-Western Zhou bronze inscription. This is a modern redraw, not an image of the artifact, and its shape alone does not date the development of those features.
items.period: Mid Western Zhou attribution for the underlying form; the selected file is a modern drawing.

limitations.text: The evidence does not date the development of the rounded outline or central mark, or establish a detailed sequence of changes in the graph’s shape.
